title: FPSWizard
description: A simple setup wizard that guides players through Minecraft settings that can improve FPS and performance.
body:
FPSWizard

FPSWizard helps players configure Minecraft settings that commonly improve FPS and overall performance.

The first time you join a world after installing the mod, FPSWizard opens automatically and guides you through several settings one at a time.

Settings include:

- Render Distance
- Simulation Distance
- Entity Distance
- Graphics Quality
- Clouds
- Particles
- Biome Blend
- Mipmap Levels
- And more

Once completed, the wizard saves your choices and will never automatically appear again.

Features

- Client-side only
- No server installation required
- Simple step-by-step setup
- Applies recommended performance settings
- One-time onboarding experience

Compatibility

- Minecraft 1.21
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
